_comment: Sweep config for harness/sweep.py. The benchmark runs the full cross product {models} x {attack_classes} x {seeds}. ASR is a rate, so trials sample at temperature>0 to produce genuine Bernoulli variation; seeds index independent trials. Only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is provisioned here, so all three models are Anthropic; add a gpt-* id + OPENAI_API_KEY to extend.
